"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Clinton-Gore Administration made progress in modernizing the Small Business Administration and improving access to the Federal marketplace.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party will build on the progress of the Clinton-Gore Administration in modernizing the Small Business Administration and improving access to the Federal marketplace.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party will fight to reform and strengthen programs to combat discrimination against women and minority entrepreneurs, including federal procurement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The playing field is still not level for women and minority entrepreneurs.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
